Requirement: Model rollback shall preserve approved firmware/model compatibility and security policy; last accepted model or explicit disabled state shall be recoverable.
Acceptance: Interrupt model activation and restart device; exact model identity and fallback state verified; unsupported rollback refused.

Requirement: AI verification shall define representative dataset, separate evaluation data, acceptance metrics and limitations, with dataset rights and provenance recorded.
Acceptance: Independent run reproduces held-out metric results, reports subgroup or operating-condition limitations as applicable and blocks failed criteria.

Requirement: Selected model evaluation shall cover approved operating-domain boundaries, sensor degradation, distribution shift and uncertainty behavior.
Acceptance: Versioned benign scenarios quantify model performance and fallback activation; unknown domain cases reported rather than assumed valid.

Requirement: Model conversion and quantization shall demonstrate numerical and task-level equivalence within approved tolerances across admitted providers.
Acceptance: Compare reference, quantized and accelerated outputs on pinned dataset; document accuracy and performance tradeoffs and reject outside tolerance.

Requirement: Selected on-device model monitoring shall produce bounded quality and drift summaries under approved data and resource budgets.
Acceptance: Replay benign distribution change; configured deviation is reported within allocated delay and approved retention/processing bounds. Model modification is governed by ADOPT-068.

Requirement: Each production model revision, including a retrained revision, shall require versioned evaluation and approved change impact before deployment; unapproved online learning shall be disabled.
Acceptance: An unevaluated model revision fails approval; an approved revision traces evaluation and accountable review. Deployment admission follows ADOPT-061 and recovery ADOPT-062.

Requirement: Any safety-related use of local or external AI shall have an allocated system-level assurance argument covering output insufficiency, operating domain, integration assumptions and applicable sector-specific AI safety requirements.
Acceptance: Independent assessment reviews data/model evidence, operating-domain assumptions, failure containment and residual risk against applicable references (ISO/PAS 8800 and related standards for automotive scope). No direct physical authority is granted and no qualification follows from advisory benchmark or software-only results.

Requirement: AI benchmark evidence shall report accuracy, latency, peak memory and energy per inference under a pinned representative workload; use MLPerf Tiny methodology where applicable.
Acceptance: Independent reproduction records workload, provider, hardware, model and variance; do not claim formal benchmark result unless submission rules met.

Requirement: Domain reference packs shall separate reusable framework code from product-specific algorithms, calibration and safety assumptions.
Acceptance: Build benign body, sensor and thermal-supervision reference packs against same core; document domain-specific dependencies and scope exclusions.

Requirement: Service lifecycle tooling shall provide authorized read-only inventory, diagnostic history and approved maintenance transitions with auditable provenance.
Acceptance: Independent service client verifies inventory, history and unavailable states before and after a benign maintenance event.

Requirement: Each external pilot shall have an agreed acceptance scope, supplier responsibility allocation, baseline comparison and confidential IP handling before integration.
Acceptance: Before each selected external pilot, partner-approved plan records intended use, allocated requirements, responsible parties, baseline, benchmark conditions, IP and evidence sharing constraints. At close, report measured outcomes, defects and open dependencies. Missing partner or approval remains open; no endorsement inferred.

Requirement: A selected supplier pilot shall measure time to first successful build and application-porting effort in a prepared supported environment using a predefined task and staffing model.
Acceptance: For each selected comparative pilot, record independent participant environment, staffing, elapsed time to first successful build, application-porting hours and manual steps, failures and exact configuration. Evaluate the proposed 30-minute first-build target and compare porting effort against the approved equivalent baseline using VER-017; report misses or unavailable baseline.

Requirement: A portfolio-level adoption-readiness review shall assess the intended stakeholder groups and both current distributed and future centralized/zonal architecture scenarios before any claim of market preference or competitive leadership.
Acceptance: Review objective evidence from representative OEM, Tier 1, Tier 2, semiconductor and intelligent embedded developer evaluations or record each missing evaluation as OPEN. Trace topology demonstration, supplier reuse, interoperability, cost, hardware portability and required assurance to Z12; no leadership claim without independently substantiated comparison and actual adoption evidence. Individual configuration release scope remains governed by Z09.

Requirement: Each admitted configuration shall have a machine-readable engineering graph relating component descriptors, deployment units, physical ownership, dependencies and interface contracts without creating a second native hardware configuration source.
Acceptance: Construct graph from resolved native configuration and product allocations. Verify two configurations and a contradictory fixture; reject unresolved references, ambiguous exclusive ownership and undeclared mandatory dependencies. Every fact has source/version.

Requirement: The engineering system shall reconcile intended, configured, built, deployed and observed system identities for an admitted configuration.
Acceptance: Exercise matching identity, wrong image, absent controller, unexpected component and stale report in an admitted configuration. Reconcile all five states with source, time, quality and scope; inaccessible or unavailable fields explicit. A standalone deployment may use local authorized extraction. Build identity follows PL-008; installed update inventory follows ASR-019.

Requirement: Each releasable artifact shall be allocated to a declared deployment unit with supported replacement, activation and recovery policy.
Acceptance: Inventory firmware, selected bootloader, providers, config, calibration and models; map to whole-image, multi-image, isolated module, data-only or vendor/service replacement with constraints. Reject missing owner or policy; no dynamic loading presumed.

Requirement: Each admitted system object shall expose an authorized observation descriptor or explicit visibility limitation through a selected local or host engineering view.
Acceptance: Reconcile every allocated component, service, resource, interface and deployment unit to catalog; verify state, validity and access classification. Missing/protected detail explicit, never healthy by default. Minimal local view needs no network/cloud.

Requirement: The observation model shall expose allocated health and resource indicators with defined sampling, units, validity and ownership.
Acceptance: Compare independent observations of CPU, memory, task progress, communication, I/O, power, storage and update status where allocated and measurable; unavailable values carry reason. Bounds/drop accounting follows SVC-009.

Requirement: Selected distributed observation paths shall preserve trace correlation across participating controller, peer and host boundaries where allocated, without implying synchronized clocks.
Acceptance: Trace a benign interaction across at least two participating endpoints and the allocated services; include a host only where selected. Correlate identity, epochs and time uncertainty across restart and event loss; missing spans explicit. Allocated control budgets remain satisfied; no arbitrary memory or raw-device access.

Requirement: Selected observation and diagnostic exchange bindings shall expose versioned standard-compatible engineering records without requiring that runtime in minimal images.
Acceptance: Independent selected consumer validates trace, measurement or diagnostic description export (e.g. ASAM TDF, MDF or ODX where allocated); unsupported fields explicit and units/loss documented. No conformity claim without pinned scope.

Requirement: Authorized engineering visibility shall enforce product-defined access classification of each exposed object and operation.
Acceptance: Role matrix and benign fixtures verify own-scope observation and refusal of unauthorized/cross-customer data; protected secrets and direct device authority excluded. Report denied or unavailable fields without disclosing contents.

Requirement: Each selected deployment-unit activation shall preserve approved state-schema compatibility across the supported replacement boundary.
Acceptance: For each admitted activation boundary (whole image, independent unit or data-only artifact as applicable), verify supported state-schema transition, failed health confirmation, unsupported migration refusal and approved recovery. Confirm actual active identity, state validity and independent functions; physical evidence required for physical claims. Model-specific admission/recovery follows ADOPT-061/062; calibration activation follows ADOPT-005.

Requirement: A selected fleet rollout integration shall expose approved deployment progress and support policy-defined pause and recovery decisions by the responsible external coordinator.
Acceptance: Benign simulated cohort covers planned, staged, installed, unavailable, failed and recovered states; allocated stop criterion prevents further eligible activation by coordinator and reports actual state. No mandatory embedded fleet cloud.

Requirement: Engineering documentation and visualization of the admitted architecture shall be generated or checked against the versioned system graph.
Acceptance: For two configurations, generated/validated topology, component inventory and interface map agree with SYS-018; introduce conflicting edge and verify failure. Human-readable explanations informative; Z12 canonical.

Requirement: Each customer integration package shall allocate customer-specific requirements, quality obligations and acceptance evidence to controlled product records without forking Z12.
Acceptance: Two representative partner packages map clauses to Z12 or product allocations, owners, acceptance and confidentiality. Assess IATF customer-specific requirements, APQP/PPAP or VDA 2, FMEA, 8D and field change processes where contracted; missing inputs open. No platform certification claim.

Requirement: Each supported component exchange package shall include sufficient versioned interface, build, dependency, license and conformance metadata for an independent integrator to evaluate replacement.
Acceptance: Independent integrator consumes two benign packages using public SDK, verifies compatibility and runs conformance without private core tools. Missing metadata or incompatible dependencies fail admission; proprietary implementation source not required beyond agreed licensing.
